title: Services inflation proving sticky
summary: Argues trimmed mean is tracking above the RBA's forecast path, driven by insurance, rents and market services. Sees the bar for further easing as high into early 2027.
points: Risk skewed to a hawkish hold in December

title: Labour market cooling at the margins
summary: Hours worked and job ads both softened in recent months, though the unemployment rate remains low. Suggests a gradual loosening rather than a sharp turn.
points: Job ads down for third straight month

title: China stimulus and the iron ore outlook
summary: Reviews the latest round of Chinese property support measures. Views the impact on steel demand as modest, keeping iron ore range-bound and the terms of trade drifting lower.
points: AUD sensitivity to iron ore has fallen
